title: Self-Serviced IoT: Practical and Private IoT Computation Offloading with Full User Control
reasoning: The paper focuses on protecting user privacy in IoT devices through technical solutions like encryption, key management, and secure offloading. While privacy is an ethical consideration, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves; rather, it implements solutions to address privacy risks within a technical system. It does not go beyond typical system-design-related ethical considerations.
